name: Todoist
description: Your tasks for today, or any Todoist filter, as a list
comment: API v1, GET /api/v1/tasks/filter with a required query; the answer is paginated ({results, next_cursor}), 50 tasks by default. priority runs from 1 (normal) to 4 (urgent), the reverse of the app's p1 label. The rate limit of these endpoints is not published (unverified).

placeholders.label: Filter
placeholders.hint: A Todoist filter as you type it in the app, such as today, overdue or #Household.

source.name: Todoist
source.secretHint: In Todoist, under Settings, Integrations, Developer: copy the API token.

rule.summary: show urgent tasks in the warning colour
